spans.s: aṭha-gānī, a billon coin equal to 8 copper jitals and to (1/6) of a silver ṭaṅka; there are do-gānī ((1/4) ṭaṅka), cau-gānī ((1/2) ṭaṅka), cha-gānī ((3/4) ṭaṅka), bārah-gānī (1(1/2) ṭaṅkas), caubīs-gānī (3 ṭaṅkas), aḍatālīs-gānī (6 taṅkas). See JNSI, Vol. XXII, pp. 198-99.
